item.title: YTKACE v21.42.4
item.description:
YouTube 21.42.4 | YTKACE 1.1.4 | YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.42.4 • Added a SponsorBlock button to the player to whitelist channels, vote on segments and submit new ones • Added Report AI Channels to report channels to AiSList from the ⋯ menu • Added Clean Copied Links to remove tracking like si= from links you copy or share • Added options to remove items from the ⋯ menu • Added Tab Bar options for Liquid Glass: Default, YTKACE, YouTube or Off • Added Keep Shorts in Home, Search and on Channels
Fixed: • Remove Previous/Next not working in playlists • Blank space left when fullscreen actions are hidden • Remove Mixes missing some mixes
YouTube 21.42.4 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_21.42.4.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.4_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16

item.title: YTKACE v21.41.5
item.description:
YouTube 21.41.5 | YTKACE 1.1.3 | YTKACE_1.1.3_YouTube_21.41.5
by @itzzace0
What's new: • Updated to YouTube 21.41.5 • Added Hide AI Channels, which hides videos from channels on the AiSList blocklist in your feed and search, with an option for the warnlist too • Swipe the SponsorBlock popup away to dismiss it
Fixed: • Shorts download button sometimes missing on the new Shorts UI • Auto-Skip and Play Shorts Once not working on the new Shorts UI • Pinch to fullscreen in Shorts freezing or starting the next Short • Loop button not looping when Local Queue is on • SponsorBlock popup not fading in • Chapter pill in the player sometimes not getting Liquid Glass
YouTube 21.41.5 requires iOS 17, so there are two IPAs: • `YTKACE_1.1.3_YouTube_21.41.5.ipa` for iOS 17 and newer • `YTKACE_1.1.3_YouTube_iOS16_21.33.6.ipa` for iOS 16
